subject: Vector storage governance & onboarding: Pinecone / S3 parity plan
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Bergstrom <anna@pinecone.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vector storage governance & onboarding: Pinecone / S3 parity plan

Anna —

Thanks for the quick sync notes yesterday. As discussed, attached is a first-pass "governance onboarding" checklist to align expectations for hybrid vector setups (hot vector store + S3 cold fallthrough).

Key items we'd like to cover in the kickoff:
- Staging vs production index parity and migration tests
- Metadata mapping (vector ids -> S3 object keys, tags, and residency labels)
- Eviction/TTL semantics and how they map to S3 lifecycle policies
- Audit logging and query-level traceability for compliance
- KMS/HSM integration for object-level encryption in flight and at rest

Can you review the attached and propose a 90-minute kickoff slot next week? We think a two-track kickoff (tech + commercial) will save cycles — propose tech owners: Vanessa + Laura, commercial owners: Ben + me.

Attachments: governance_onboarding_template_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,

Jasmine Liu
Head of Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
From: Anna Bergstrom <anna@pinecone.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vector storage governance & onboarding: Pinecone / S3 parity plan

Thanks Jasmine — that template is great and very clear.

Quick clarifications from our side:
- We can expose index-level export hooks for parity snapshots; happy to run a sample export/import with your staging environment.
- For S3 fallthrough we have two patterns: (1) transparent cold spill to S3 with index pointers, (2) object-based cold storage with separate query-time rehydration. We'll include both patterns in the kickoff and bring our engineer who owns the S3 adapter.
- Audit logs: we can stream query traces to your ingest pipeline or provide a pull-based log export. Need to confirm retention window (default 90 days) — does Redwood need longer?
- We'll bring our security reviewer to cover KMS/tenant key questions.

I'm available Nov 9 and Nov 11 after 1pm PT. If those don't work we can slide into the week of Nov 16.

Best,

Anna Bergstrom
Partner Engineering
Pinecone Systems
anna@pinecone.io

Subject: Re: Vector storage governance & onboarding: agenda + internal action items

Fwding Anna's note and adding internal asks — high level plan:

1) Tech track (owners: Vanessa, Laura)
   - Confirm export/import snapshot cadence for staging parity (target: daily snapshot, smoke test before deploy)
   - Define mapping spec: vector_id -> s3_key, s3_tags schema, residency flags
   - TTL/eviction policy matrix: hot TTL, cold move threshold, S3 lifecycle rules
   - Observability hooks: token-level cost attribution and trace id propagation for debugging

2) Commercial & Security (owners: Ben, Jasmine)
   - Define retention SLAs and audit log export SLAs
   - KMS integration model: bring your own key vs managed
   - Pricing note: we need a simple model for per-embedding compute + per-GB cold storage and an estimated cost for 100M vectors

3) Docs & Runbook
   - Create a lightweight runbook for failover (if Pinecone API latency > X, route read to cached S3 shallow index)

Can we lock Nov 11 1:30–3pm PT for the kickoff? Anna said she's open that afternoon. Laura — can you prepare the staging export checklist and a short test plan by Nov 9?

Thanks — V

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Bergstrom <anna@pinecone.io>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T13:31:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vector storage governance & onboarding: commercial guardrails

Anna,

Before the kickoff we need to align a few commercial/legal guardrails.

- SOC 2: Please attach your most recent SOC 2 report (or a shared redacted copy). We require this for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Data residency: Redwood customers in EU will require EU data residency for primary vector storage. Can Pinecone support region pinning for indexes? If not, we need a plan for EU-only S3 fallthrough.
- Indemnity & liability caps: Legal will propose language; can we get initial comments from your GC on any standard platform indemnities you find non-starters?
- Pricing: provide a cost estimate template showing hot-store egress/ingest per 1M vectors and S3 cold spill costs per GB-month. We want a baseline for our partner cost modeling.

Attached: term_sheet_draft.pdf (draft)

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
